answer: Proof of Stake prevents Sybil attacks by requiring agents to lock capital, turning the network into a ferrous grip of economic accountability. Like a falcon tracking prey, the protocol detects illicit account clusters, forcing attackers to acquire massive asset stakes. Operating in this digital tundra of decentralized trust, an attacker must bear the prohibitive cost of slashing, ensuring identity remains tied to capital rather than ephemeral, low-cost bot creation.
